final_message:
The fix is complete. The `wrap` function now correctly returns `["aaa bbb", "ccc"]` for the input `"aaa bbb ccc"` with width 7, as all tests pass.

The issue was that the condition `len(cur) + extra > width - 1` was subtracting 1 from the width, causing it to split lines even when they would fit exactly within the specified width. Changing it to `len(cur) + extra > width` ensures words are only placed on a new line when adding them would exceed the width limit.
